```{r si-setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 4.6, dpi = 300
)

# --- repo root (this file lives at <repo>/supplement/) -----------------------
.here <- tryCatch(normalizePath(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))),
                  error = function(e) normalizePath("."))
REPO_ROOT <- .here
while (!file.exists(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "code", "R", "build_all_numbers.R")) &&
       dirname(REPO_ROOT) != REPO_ROOT) REPO_ROOT <- dirname(REPO_ROOT)

source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "code", "R", "formatting.R"))   # fmt_*, si_kable*, si_require
si_require(c("dplyr","tidyr","stringr","knitr","kableExtra","ggplot2","scales","patchwork"))
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "code", "R", "access.R"))       # num()/est()/lo()/hi()/pv()/nn()
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "code", "R", "figures_v2.R"))   # dynamic SI figures over all_numbers
si_require("grf")                                           # pooled causal-forest module
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "code", "R", "ext_causal_forest.R")) # fit_causal_forest() + fig_cf_* (cached renders)

# THE single source of truth: every number/table/figure derives from this live
# recompute over raw + cached data (build_all_numbers(); no targets, no *_numbers.csv).
# load_or_build_all_numbers() falls back to a live rebuild if the cache is corrupt.
source(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "code", "R", "build_all_numbers.R"))
.built <- load_or_build_all_numbers(REPO_ROOT)
ALL_NUMBERS        <- .built$all_numbers   # global consumed by num()/est()
all_numbers        <- .built$all_numbers   # lowercase global consumed by figures_v2 (.an())
core_objects       <- .built$core
# prime the causal-forest memo from the cached fit so fig_cf_cate_distribution()
# needs NO refit on a cached-rds render (the forest is fit only when the rds is built)
if (!is.null(.built$causal_forest)) .cf_memo$fit <- .built$causal_forest
topic_bundle       <- .built$topic_bundle
survey_materials   <- .built$materials$survey_materials
key_item_wording   <- .built$materials$key_item_wording
api_prompt_strings <- .built$materials$api_prompt_strings
api_tables         <- .built$materials$api_tables
persuader_prompts  <- .built$materials$persuader_prompts
```
